title: Disposition of PR #43 (UAT swarm runtime) against the existing UAT specification in PR #15
problem: PR #43 implements the founder's master plan as a runnable agent team inside WMI. Draft PR #15 already specifies a Universally Adaptive Team for WMI. Two designs for one intended effect must not become two parallel products, and PR #43 was built without first searching open PRs.
baseline: WMI main: deterministic venture assessment, no paid model calls, no runnable UAT. PR #15: 2,552-line normative UAT specification and JSON contracts, untouched since 2026-10-01, no runtime beyond a simulation skeleton.

alternatives.name: PR #43 as the first executable slice of PR #15
alternatives.description: Keep #43's governor, mission record, earned-standing ledger, local runtime and RailScout hand-off, and map each onto #15's planes (Evidence and Decision plane, Policy Decision Service, Model Assurance) instead of a parallel UAT.
advantages: Executable mechanisms meet a reviewed specification
disadvantages: #15 assumes PostgreSQL and services that #43 does not provide

alternatives.name: PR #43 supersedes PR #15
alternatives.description: Treat the October master plan as the later, controlling founder statement and archive #15 as provenance.
disadvantages: Loses #15's threat model, approval matrix and acceptance gates
Silent narrowing of an earlier founder-reviewed design
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder states the master plan replaces the July specification.

alternatives.name: PR #15 supersedes PR #43
alternatives.description: Close #43 and build #15's full enterprise system first.
disadvantages: Months of services before any buyer test
Contradicts the founder's request to run live now
alternatives.revival_evidence: Founder prefers the enterprise build before any live cycle.

alternatives.name: Hosted agent platform
alternatives.description: Run the roles on a commercial multi-agent platform.
alternatives.revival_evidence: A platform offering verifiable cross-vendor review and local models.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: The master plan stays prose; #15 stays an unimplemented draft; no buyer test happens.
disadvantages: The founder's explicit request to build and run it is unmet
Ideas found in two live runs are lost

roles.position: Every master-plan intent is recorded with a lifecycle state; the human phase is deferred, not dropped; the July UAT design is preserved as a conflicting intent, not silently overridden.
material_concerns: Canonical owner between #15 and #43 is the founder's call

roles.position: #43 is additive, owns no authority and consumes the Kernel opportunity-packet contract. Its modules map onto #15's planes without a second authority plane.
material_concerns: Two UAT names in one repository confuse contributors until mapped

roles.position: #43 was built without the required search of open PRs, the same failure that produced a duplicate compiler in the Kernel. Its runtime also defaulted to a paid provider until dba2e66.
material_concerns: A small local model may fabricate sources
Agent standing could be gamed by same-lineage review

roles.position: Default route needs no secrets; kill switch, spend and call ceilings exist; the ledger must live on a private volume.
material_concerns: Local model quality and hardware unmeasured

roles.position: No one was contacted and nothing was spent. Evidence so far is unit tests and model output; there is no buyer evidence.
material_concerns: A completed internal workflow is not buyer demand (founder, 2026-11-12)
Run outputs may name real organizations and stay out of git

evidence.reference: 205 passed locally on dba2e66; CI green on 3326c24
evidence.finding: Deterministic gates, ledger replay and refusals pass.

1 VALIDATE, 6 PARK, 1 KILL; 13 ideas kept for RailScout.

pass_1.intended_outcome: Verified net cash from paying customers, reached through one canonical, governed UAT in WMI.

advantages.statement: Executable, tested gates for a design that was only specified
advantages.amplified_value: Becomes #15's first executable slice and the evidence base its acceptance gates lacked.
Directly implements #15's correlated-model-failure requirement; reusable by other organs.

advantages.statement: No idea lost: Kernel-valid packets to RailScout
advantages.amplified_value: Feeds the refinery loop that the organ map already routes.

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Record the conflict, map #43 modules onto #15 planes, and hold #43 in draft until the founder names the canonical owner.

disadvantages.statement: Paid model route was the default
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Fixed in dba2e66: local default, Claude opt-in only, key presence ignored.

disadvantages.statement: No buyer evidence; only model output
disadvantages.redesigned_response: VALIDATE means a capped buyer test only; kill rules attached; no COMMIT without accepted external evidence.

disadvantages.statement: Built without posting a claim on the Kernel work board
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Collaboration receipt v2 added to the PR; board claim blocked by missing Kernel API access and reported to the founder.

comparisons.do_nothing: No progress on the founder's request; duplication avoided.
comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: Governor plus one workflow (the first commit of #43).
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: #15's full enterprise system before any live cycle.
comparisons.reversible_experiment: #43 as a draft, consequence-inert experiment mapped onto #15.

rejected_alternatives.name: Hosted agent platform
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Vendor lock-in, self-review bias, open-source-first conflict.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Verifiable cross-vendor review with local models.

pass_2.attack_summary: Assume #43 is mapped onto #15 and merged. It could still harden a second vocabulary, centralize trust in one ledger, and let thin local-model research pass gates.

new_weaknesses.statement: Two vocabularies (eight roles and thirteen bots vs twelve parent agents) survive the mapping.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: One mapping table in the disposition doc; rename only after the founder rules.

new_weaknesses.statement: With one model lineage, all review grades as internal, so standing never rises.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Accepted by design; standing rises only with a second lineage or external acceptance.

new_weaknesses.statement: Live evidence on the local route depends on a SearXNG adapter that does not exist.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Uncited URLs are dropped and the governor kills unverified ideas; the adapter is a named residual deficit.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: Canonical ownership is a founder decision.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: Approval of the credentialing buyer test.

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: This session cannot post to Kernel issue #96.
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.owner: Alfonso Lopez or a session with Kernel access

pass_2.final_design: #43 stays a draft, consequence-inert experiment: local-first runtime, deterministic governor, Kernel-valid RailScout packets, and an explicit mapping onto #15's planes. No merge until the founder names the canonical UAT owner.

residual_risks.risk: Local model research quality is unmeasured
residual_risks.mitigation: Benchmark one seeded cycle before scheduling

dissent.handling: Preserved; the decision waits on the founder.

entries.position: Proceed as EXPERIMENT now; the overlap is resolvable by mapping alone.
entries.rationale: Files and interfaces do not collide; #15 has no runtime to conflict with.
entries.evidence_threshold: Founder silence for 14 days after the ruling request.

migration_plan: No migration: additive modules. On a ruling for alternative 1, add a mapping section to #15's specification and rename nothing until both PRs agree.

steps: Close or revert PR #43; no other module imports it
Keep runs/ and the ledger as evidence
Set UAT_SWARM_PAUSED=1 on any running host

kill_criteria: A normal run contacts a paid host or a key changes routing
A run sends, spends, signs or publishes without founder approval
Fewer than 2 paid pilots within 30 days of an approved buyer test
review_trigger: Founder ruling on WMI-UAT-008, or 2026-11-27 if none
